# A Vindication of the Rights of Woman

*[Wollstonecraft](../philosophers/wollstonecraft.md) · 1792*

An essay by [Mary Wollstonecraft](../philosophers/wollstonecraft.md) demanding a rational education for women: their apparent inferiority comes from their being brought up to please. It answers, among others, Rousseau's Emile.
